title: Make import-marker built-in exclusion tests discriminate
outcome: Make import-marker built-in exclusion tests discriminate
acceptance: Self-marked imported documents are rejected for known-provided built-ins and incomplete assigned properties, while the otherwise equivalent absent ordinary user property succeeds with the assumed-empty disclosure.

completion.summary: Original Codex and Claude verification confirms own unconditional true marker in every negative fixture, absent ordinary-user positive succeeds/discloses, incomplete/OS/MSBuildToolsPath controls refuse.
